notes.title: Update Notes for 27/11/2024
notes.content:
[list]
[*] Fixed Nexus' starting placement on repeat plays of levels/shops
[*] Adjusted timing in cutscene at the end of 'The Temple'
[*] Adjusted collision on pedestals in 'The Streets' to block fire
[*] Fixed blast's explosions so the enemies triggering the explosion aren't hurt by both
[*] Shrunk level icons for 'The Battlements', 'The Gatehouse', and 'The Throne Room' (and the nearby light shop) for ease of navigation
[*] Shrunk King Phemus' hitbox to better fit his actual size
[*]Removed ability to get out of bounds in 'The Village'
[*]Adjusted a cutscene trigger in 'The Mountain'
[/list]

notes.title: Fight Back The Night Official Release!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44873426/507b5fb8c1c26fce9e6eb1dc2c743d9ff966b8ee.png[/img]

After a lenghty quiet period in terms of announcements we're happy to say Fight Back The Night has been officially released!

During this launch week we'll be running a 10% discount on the game.

Further, we'd like to say that for the forseeable future 25% of what we get from sales of the game will be donated to charity!

notes.title: Fight Back The Night Preview
notes.content: Join the devs at Morpeth Jetsan as they play through the first few levels of Fight Back The Night! Feel free to ask any questions about the upcoming title, and get a glimpse at how the game plays! We'll also be talking a bit about the development of the title, from a game jam prototype to its current version!
